sophia: Hey folks — putting together a compact launchpad checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure onboarding. Need quick confirmations on 3 items: IAM creds, AMI naming, legal asset links.

ana: Love it. Can you drop the required scopes for GCP service account?

sophia: GCP SA scopes: `roles/compute.admin`, `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` — minimal for image import. I'll paste a terraform snippet.

sophia: ```hcl
resource "google_service_account" "marketplace_importer" {
  account_id   = "marketplace-importer"
  display_name = "Marketplace Importer SA"
}

resource "google_service_account_key" "key" {
  service_account_id = google_service_account.marketplace_importer.name
}
```

dave: From legal: we'll need the EULA link + the approved marketing logo set before we publish. Ana — can you point to the reseller clause we use for marketplaces?

ana: Sure — linking internal doc: https://legal.redwood.com/marketplace-eula-v2.pdf and reseller clause: section 4.2 in that doc.

chris: For Azure we need OfferID + plan SKU. Who owns the mapping table? @sophia?

sophia: I'll own OfferID mapping. Plan: crosswalk AWS AMI name -> Azure VHD name -> GCP image family. I'll push a CSV to the repo and create a small script to verify.

integrations-bot: Task created: partnerships/marketplace/mappings #324 — assignee: sophia

maria: On Dedicated customers, confirm we include `dedicated=true` tag on AMIs, otherwise reserved capacity lookup fails.

sophia: Noted. AMI tag convention: `redwood:env=prod`, `redwood:marketplace=aws-ami-v1`, `redwood:dedicated=true`.

1) GCP SA + creds (owner: ana)

4) OfferID/SKU mapping CSV (owner: sophia)
